name: Minami Kana
source: Kana is the middle sister of the Minami household and is in her second year of junior-high school. She is fairly ill-mannered and lazy compared to her sisters, preferring to spend her spare time lounging around the house and doing as little work as possible. However, depending on her overall mood and boredom levels, she is unarguably the most hyperactive of the bunch. She can be quite selfish at times, and will frequently play pranks on or tease her younger sister, Chiaki. She has a strong craving for food, especially chocolate and sweets, but is a terrible cook, so she often relies on Haruka or even Chiaki to do the cooking for her.
